result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I haven't added a test for the new behaviour. I ran `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='Landscape*'` and it passed, but that only shows existing tests still pass.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, around line 747. The branch that adds an unmatched contributor to the remainder now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`.

Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped. Configured teams are unchanged and keep all their members. A blank latest-commit date already counts as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for blank dates, so nobody is dropped for missing data.
